headline: Antarctica Limited independent director Sarikaben resigns

summary: Antarctica Limited has announced the resignation of Sarikaben from her position as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective November 19, 2026. For Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock, board composition shifts warrant monitoring for broader governance continuity.
